release_notes: RevShare and repeat deposits made visible: the affiliate network editor grows a 'Count every deposit separately' checkbox under the Postback URL that adds or removes the tid parameter and explains what to put there — with a per-deposit transaction ID every deposit on a click is its own conversion (reports show the sum, e.g. $20 + $30 + $50 = $100) and a re-delivered postback with the same tid updates its row instead of counting twice. The Postback page gets the same explanation under its 'With TID' example, the Postbacks guide gains a 'Several deposits on one click (RevShare)' section (EN/RU), and the 'With TID' label wording is fixed in de/fr/uk/zh. All new texts in all 7 panel languages.
